PES.representation: Original cropped raster figure, including source axes/labels; independent energy reference from H2.

orbitals.source: Selected paired natural orbitals from Figure 4B/C, PDF page 4
orbitals.representation: Original cropped images with occupations retained; red/blue encodes phase, not charge.
orbitals.interpretation: Whole-state change in occupations includes other orbitals; a modest 4f bonding contribution is possible. Effective bond orders ca.2.5 vs2.6, not an additional complete bond.

spectrum.representation: Published main black experimental and thick red simulated traces. If CSV supplied, digitized from source image; not original raw data. Published simulation shift is retained and not applied twice.
spectrum.figure_representation: Original published Figure 2 image, rather than an interpolated reconstruction; the supplementary digitized CSV leaves occluded samples missing and is not the displayed spectrum.

benchmark.note: CASPT2 benchmark is a distinct calculation from the SO-CASSCF simulated spectrum.

sources.used: Tables S6/S7 checked for state assignments and calculated spectroscopic constants; no raw numerical spectrum or potential-curve samples supplied.

changes: New layout and German teaching annotations; original figure excerpts used without alteration of the scientific content.
